claim: AWS Artifact is a self-service portal in the console that gives on-demand access to AWS compliance documentation and AWS agreements.
question: What is AWS Artifact?

values.display: a self-service audit artifact retrieval portal

evidence.quote: AWS Artifact, available in the console, is a self-service audit artifact retrieval portal that provides our customers with on-demand access to AWS’ compliance documentation and AWS agreements.

claim: AWS Artifact Reports is where you download AWS security and compliance documents such as ISO certifications, PCI and SOC reports.
question: Where do you download AWS SOC, PCI or ISO reports?

values.display: You can use AWS Artifact Reports

evidence.quote: You can use AWS Artifact Reports to download AWS security and compliance documents, such as AWS ISO certifications, Payment Card Industry (PCI), and System and Organization Control (SOC) reports.

claim: AWS Artifact Agreements is where you review, accept and track the status of AWS agreements such as the Business Associate Addendum (BAA).
question: Where do you accept an AWS agreement such as the BAA?

values.display: You can use AWS Artifact Agreements

evidence.quote: You can use AWS Artifact Agreements to review, accept, and track the status of AWS agreements such as the Business Associate Addendum (BAA).

claim: All AWS accounts have access to AWS Artifact; non-admin IAM users need access granted through IAM permissions.
question: Who has access to AWS Artifact?

values.display: All AWS Accounts have access to AWS Artifact

evidence.quote: All AWS Accounts have access to AWS Artifact. Root users and IAM users with admin permissions can download all audit artifacts available to their account by agreeing to the associated terms and conditions.
You will need to grant IAM users with non-admin permissions access to AWS Artifact using IAM permissions.

claim: To give auditors AWS compliance reports, the FAQ suggests IAM credentials per auditor, limited to the reports relevant to that audit.
question: How do you give an auditor access to AWS compliance reports?

values.display: creating IAM user credentials specific to each auditor

evidence.quote: You can easily accomplish this by creating IAM user credentials specific to each auditor and configuring the credentials so that the auditor can only access the reports that are relevant to the audit that they are conducting.

note: d119. Book rule: no IAM users in tasks; writers may prefer roles or Identity Center and should say the FAQ wording is IAM users.

claim: There is no limit on Artifact downloads: you can download all available artifacts at any time, as many times as you need.
question: Is there a limit to how many artifacts you can download from AWS Artifact?

values.display: as many times as you need

evidence.quote: You can access and download all available artifacts at any time, as many times as you need.

claim: You may share an AWS compliance report with your customers only if the terms and conditions of that specific report allow it; customers can also get the reports from their own AWS account.
question: Can you share AWS compliance reports from Artifact with your customers?

values.display: if permitted by the terms and conditions

qualifiers.condition: terms on the first page of the report

evidence.quote: You can share the AWS compliance reports with your customers directly if permitted by the terms and conditions applicable to the specific AWS compliance report.
Additionally, your customers can access AWS compliance reports using their own AWS Account.

claim: Third-party (AWS Marketplace ISV) compliance reports in Artifact are available only to customers granted access to AWS Marketplace Vendor Insights for that ISV.
question: Who can see third-party compliance reports in AWS Artifact?

values.display: granted access to AWS Marketplace Vendor Insights

evidence.quote: Third-party (AWS Marketplace Independent Software Vendor (ISV)) compliance reports will only be accessible to those AWS customers who have been granted access to AWS Marketplace Vendor Insights for a specific ISV.

claim: The Business Associate Addendum (BAA) in Artifact Agreements is for customers who must comply with HIPAA.
question: Which AWS agreement is for customers who must comply with HIPAA?

evidence.quote: For example, the Business Associate Addendum (BAA) is available for customers that need to comply with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).

claim: Before entering an agreement in Artifact Agreements you must accept the Artifact NDA, and each agreement is confidential and cannot be shared outside your company.
question: Can you share an agreement from AWS Artifact Agreements outside your company?

evidence.quote: Before you enter into an agreement on AWS Artifact Agreements, you must download and agree to the terms of the AWS Artifact nondisclosure agreement (NDA). Each agreement is confidential and cannot be shared with others outside of your company.

note: contrast with reports, which may be shared when their terms allow

claim: An Artifact account agreement applies only to the account that accepted it; an organization agreement applies to all accounts in the organization, and only the management account can accept it.
question: What is the difference between Artifact account agreements and organization agreements?

values.display: Only the management account in an organization can accept agreements

evidence.quote: When accepted, AWS Artifact Account Agreements (located under the Account agreements tab) apply only to the individual account you used to sign into AWS.
Only the management account in an organization can accept agreements in AWS Artifact Organization Agreements.

note: display is 10 words verbatim; registrar may shorten to 'Only the management account'

claim: Artifact organization agreements are available only for accounts that use AWS Organizations.
question: Can an account outside an organization use Artifact organization agreements?

values.display: only available for accounts using AWS Organizations

evidence.quote: No, AWS Artifact Organization Agreements is only available for accounts using AWS Organizations.

claim: In an account designated as a HIPAA Account you may use any AWS service, but PHI may be included only in HIPAA Eligible Services.
question: Which services can hold PHI in a HIPAA account covered by a BAA?

values.display: you may only include PHI in HIPAA Eligible Services

evidence.quote: You may use any AWS service in an account designated as a HIPAA Account, but you may only include PHI in HIPAA Eligible Services.

claim: AWS provides AWS Artifact documents and agreements free of charge.
question: How much does AWS Artifact cost?

evidence.quote: AWS provides AWS Artifact documents and agreements to you free of charge.

note: d119 cost: the FAQ does not state Artifact's price; taken from the user guide Pricing section.
